# THEA - The House of Comfort Living

> THEA (thealiving.in) is an Indian online home-furnishing brand by Theatic Brands Private Limited, Faridabad, Haryana. It designs and sells king size, double and super king bedsheet sets with pillow covers, reversible comforters and anti-slip floor mats, with free shipping across India.

## Key facts
- Brand: THEA, The House of Comfort Living
- Legal entity: Theatic Brands Private Limited
- Address: H. No 4165, First Floor, Aradhya Homes, Ansal Versalia, Sector 67 & 67A, Faridabad, Haryana 122101, India
- Contact: care@thealiving.in, +91 87961 46616 (Mon-Fri, 10 am - 5 pm IST), WhatsApp available
- Ships to: all of India, free shipping on every order, cash on delivery available
- Returns: 3-day return and exchange from delivery
- Offer: buy any 2 bedsheets for flat 50% off (BUY2), any 3 for 56% off (BUY3)

## Sizes
- Double bedsheet: 90 x 100 in, fits 60 x 75 in mattress, 2 pillow covers 18 x 28 in
- King bedsheet: 100 x 108 in, fits 72 x 78 in mattress (6 x 6.5 ft), 2 pillow covers 20 x 30 in
- Super King bedsheet: 108 x 108 in, fits 72 x 78 in mattress up to 10 in deep
